result.title: When gene summaries reveal the answers: Gene Ontology circularity in gene embedding benchmarks
result.comment: 31 pages, including supplementary material. GeneProv benchmark and leaderboard: https://hwang595.github.io/gene-embedding-exposure/
result.summary: A gene summary can contain the very annotations used to evaluate an embedding of its text. The Alliance of Genome Resources converts Gene Ontology (GO) annotations into sentences, which NCBI Gene displays and GenePT includes in its input. These summaries covered 6,172 of 19,256 human protein-coding genes (32.1%), including 58% of genes with one to ten linked publications. We embedded the same corpus with and without the generated summaries and refitted a function-prediction probe on each version. Among genes with one to ten publications, removal reduced the reported per-gene area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) by 0.078 with a linear probe (95% bootstrap interval 0.072-0.084) and by 0.033 with a multilayer perceptron. These estimates use a historical GO scorer that mishandled ties. The original predictions are unavailable for rescoring. A simple TF-IDF encoder also benefited from the summaries, as did models evaluated only on experimental annotations. Replacing generated summaries with UniProt function descriptions recovered much of the lost performance despite little verbatim overlap. UniProt also curates many of the evaluation labels. In mouse and yeast, we found a similar dependence on the source of the description. We introduce GeneProv to compare encoders on matched text and to examine how representation rankings change across GO recovery, non-GO endpoints and co-essentiality.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 NCBI Gene 摘要中含有被用作评测标签的 GO 注释，构成基因嵌入基准的循环泄露；作者在同一语料上增删这些生成摘要并重新拟合功能预测探针，量化性能虚高幅度，并提出 GeneProv 用于匹配文本下的编码器比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「去掉含答案信息的输入再重拟合探针」的做法可能为 LVR 中判别表征是否真正依赖视觉证据、而非语言先验或捷径提供评价思路，匹配文本对照与跨端点排序稳定性可供核查。
